# arrstack_secret_backend (Resource)

Mounts the arrstack secrets engine and writes its config: the arrproxy base URL and admin token.

## Example Usage

```terraform
variable "arrproxy_admin_token" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}

resource "arrstack_secret_backend" "arrstack" {
  path        = "arrstack"
  base_url    = "https://arrproxy.example.com"
  admin_token = var.arrproxy_admin_token

  request_timeout_seconds = 30
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `admin_token` (String, Sensitive) arrproxy admin token the engine authenticates with. Write-only; never read back.
- `base_url` (String) Base URL of the arrproxy deployment (e.g. https://arrproxy.example.com).
- `path` (String) Mount path for the arrstack secrets engine (e.g. "arrstack").

### Optional

- `ca_cert` (String, Sensitive) PEM CA certificate that signed the arrproxy server's TLS certificate (optional; omit to use the system trust store). Write-only; never read back.
- `description` (String) Human-readable description of the mount.
- `plugin` (String) Name of the plugin in the catalog to mount. Defaults to vault-plugin-secrets-arrstack.
- `request_timeout_seconds` (Number) HTTP timeout in seconds for calls from the engine to arrproxy. Defaults to 30.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by mount path. admin_token and ca_cert are write-only, so set them in
# configuration after importing.
terraform import arrstack_secret_backend.arrstack arrstack
```
